text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while taking a walk along the riverbank——
Taaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Dash dash dash dash...!!*)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The one who dashes as if taking flight! Her name is—?
El! Condor! Pasaaaa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Catching up to the wind, overtaking it, and leaving it behind!
This is the champion's mighty stride, desuu!!
choice_data_list: Are you in the middle of training?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Sí! That's right!
Did you find yourself mesmerized by El's running?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's only natural, desu.
After all, El is the strongest in the world!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I am always honing myself so that I am ready
whenever a challenger appears, desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Bueno! And on that note,
I shall resume my passionate running—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa-whoa-whoa-whoa!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Estoy bien, I am fine, desu.
However...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Instead of my leg twisting,
my shoe was sacrificed in its place.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
——Ha!
Could it be that something happened to Grass!?
choice_data_list: I doubt that has anything to do with it, but...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, desu. Just a customary joke!
I am quite used to footwear accidents, after all.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Alright then! It's time to let this shoe
enter the 'Hall of Fame' as well!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fufun... Are you curious?
Then you may come along, desu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Where El Condor Pasa led me
was an inconspicuous corner behind the school building.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Look, please read the writing on the box
placed over there!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
This is the resting place for all the generations of shoes
that have trained together with El——

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It is a 'Hall of Fame'
to praise the great luchadoras, desu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inside the box placed quietly behind the school building...
was a massive collection of shoes stored away.
choice_data_list: Every single one is torn or broken...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now then, you who have fulfilled your role...
Please rest peacefully here, desu.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...There we go.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
I will never forget how you supported El's legs.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Sunny days, rainy days.
Turf, dirt... How to run in all four seasons.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I learned so much together with everyone.
...I was taught so much by everyone.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I will keep pushing forward from here on out——
So please watch over me with peace of mind.
choice_data_list: ...I'll say a prayer with you too.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
——¡Sí!
I am sure the luchadoras in the Hall of Fame will be delighted!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Along with the history run alongside
countless shoes and countless heroes——

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El, as the strongest horse girl,
shall spread her wings across the world, desu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The shoes that protected her whenever her legs were on the verge of breaking.
El Condor Pasa's running seems to be built atop their foundation.
